observed: On public diagrams.net v31.4.5, both Lists visibly retained Item 1, Item 2, and Item 3 inside their borders after sequential drops into the Horizontal Flow Layout. No detached items observed.
steps: Open https://app.diagrams.net/?splash=0&storage=device in a fresh unauthenticated Chromium context, viewport 1600x1100.
Expand Advanced and Entity Relation palettes.
Drag two Entity Relation List templates and one Advanced Horizontal Flow Layout template onto the real editor canvas.
Drag first List by header into empty lower space in the layout; capture screenshot.
Drag second List by header into empty right/lower space in the outer layout; capture screenshot.
Inspect both Lists and Help menu version (v31.4.5).
limitation: One run on current public v31.4.5 using headless Chromium, rather than reporter v27.0.5 on Windows. Visual containment checked; no historical-version test.
